triplet: Ra, Executive Order: change turn order; sent lion to eat humanity, they stopped clapping.
songLine: Ra, Executive Order: change turn order; sent lion to eat humanity, because they stopped clapping.
reason: Spoken, the comma hides the cause-and-effect; the printed lore says 'because they stopped clapping'. The joke carries the clapping running gag, so it has to land.

songLine: Khepri, Resurrection Roll: retrieves card; moves sun like ball of poop. It's a living.
reason: Stray question mark forces a questioning tone on a plain power; punctuation aligned with the other lines (power: effect; lore).
